resources.string: Your jobs are listed under this name at the print release station.
Set a name before printing to UofT printers. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
Connect to the UofT network first. Then choose Print in any app, then pick one of your printers. Collect the job at the release station with your TCard within two hours.
Turn on the printers you use
Switch on printers below and they appear in the system print dialog. If they don\'t, turn on UofT Print in the system print settings.
%1$d of %2$d shown in the print dialog
Add any printer that accepts LPD jobs, using its host and queue name.
Preselected in the print dialog. You can still change it for each job.
This printer has no duplex unit, so it always prints one-sided.
For colour pages. Sharp sends about four times as much data. Black-and-white pages are always sent at 600 dpi.
It disappears from the print dialog. You can add it again later.
Use what the printer\'s Linux driver would use. Most office printers speak PostScript; choose PCL for PCL-only printers.
Set your release name in UofT Print first, so you can find the job at the printer.
